item.title: Marine forecast — 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
item.description:
NWS Forecast for: 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
Atlantic Ocean
Issued by: National Weather Service Gray/Portland, ME
Last Update: 6:28 am EDT Sep 7, 2026

Labor Day: WNW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming WSW in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas 1 to 2 ft.

Tonight: WNW wind around 10 kt. Mostly clear. Seas around 2 ft.

Tuesday: WNW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming W in the afternoon. Partly sunny, then gradually becoming sunny. Seas 1 to 2 ft.

Tuesday Night: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Mostly cloudy. Seas around 1 ft.

Wednesday: ESE wind around 10 kt becoming SSE in the afternoon. Mostly cloudy. Seas 1 to 2 ft.

Wednesday Night: SSW wind 15 to 18 kt increasing to 17 to 20 kt after midnight. Winds could gust as high as 25 kt. Showers, mainly after 11pm. Seas 3 ft building to 5 ft.

Thursday: SW wind 15 to 20 kt. Showers likely before 2pm, then a chance of showers after 3pm. Seas 5 to 6 ft.

Thursday Night: W wind around 10 kt becoming WNW after midnight. A chance of showers. Seas 4 to 5 ft.

Friday: NW wind around 10 kt becoming W in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas around 3 ft.


Marine Point Forecast: 43.7°N 69.44°W
